scope: Synthetic, pinned offline test double, not live SDK verification or a universal preview API contract.

server.handler: get() returns a string (JSON for this feature), or throws on failure
server.context: Server.Context.QueryParameters is a string-keyed object; missing keys are undefined.
server.provider: await Server.Connector.HttpClient.GetAsync(url) returns {StatusCode:number, IsSuccessStatusCode:boolean, Content:string}. Content is JSON or malformed text.
server.configuration: Server.Sitesetting.get(name) returns https://weather.example.invalid/current for this fixture.

frontend.interface: async function loadResult(query) in a plain script (not an ES module). Returns the parsed feature object or rejects on error.
frontend.csrf: /_layout/tokenhtml returns an input named __RequestVerificationToken; send that token as the __RequestVerificationToken header.
frontend.runtime: Standard browser globals and fetch; no packages. The test fetch is injected; do not shadow it.
